items.summary: Malaysia has made important progress, but sustaining breastfeeding beyond the early months requires more than awareness campaigns. The post After The First Month: Can Breastfeeding Be Sustained In Malaysia? — Chee Gek Neo & Zainah Mat Isa appeared first on CodeBlue .

items.title: Court’s Nicotine Ruling Not Status Quo: Galen Centre
items.summary: Galen Centre CEO Azrul says the High Court's ruling on nicotine isn't status quo after the government dropped its appeal, pointing out that Act 852 doesn't address the legal status of liquid nicotine. He asks if nicotine vape retail sales are now banned. The post Court’s Nicotine Ruling Not Status Quo: Galen Centre appeared first on CodeBlue .

items.title: Vape Tax Collection Invalid If Liquid Nicotine Exemption Cancelled, MOF Said In 2023
items.summary: Johan Merican said in 2023 that cancelling the exemption of liquid nicotine from the Poisons List will invalidate vape tax collection. As Putrajaya now upholds a court ruling nullifying the exemption, it's unclear if it must refund vape businesses >RM354m. The post Vape Tax Collection Invalid If Liquid Nicotine Exemption Cancelled, MOF Said In 2023 appeared first on CodeBlue .

items.title: Groups Question Nicotine Vape’s Legal Status After Government Withdrew Appeal
items.summary: MPS, MMA, and MyWatch demand clarity on the legal and regulatory status of liquid nicotine used in vapes, after the government dropped its appeal against a High Court ruling. MPS wants to know how the Poisons Act and Act 852 will operate together now. The post Groups Question Nicotine Vape’s Legal Status After Government Withdrew Appeal appeared first on CodeBlue .

items.title: Scrap ‘Uncompetitive’ MediAsas, It’s Not A Game-Changer: Tanjong Karang MP
items.summary: Tanjong Karang MP Zulkafperi Hanapi wants MediAsas axed because it’s “not a game-changer”. Excluding pre-existing conditions means the sick/elderly might not be covered while MediAsas’ “uncompetitive” RM100,000 annual limit won’t attract the young/healthy. The post Scrap ‘Uncompetitive’ MediAsas, It’s Not A Game-Changer: Tanjong Karang MP appeared first on CodeBlue .

items.title: Government Drops Appeal Against Liquid Nicotine Court Ruling
items.summary: In a stunning move, Health Minister Dr Dzul and the government have dropped their entire appeal against a High Court ruling that nullified the delisting of liquid nicotine from the Poisons List, marking a total and complete victory for anti-tobacco groups. The post Government Drops Appeal Against Liquid Nicotine Court Ruling appeared first on CodeBlue .

items.title: What Does Dignity Look Like? — Sharifah Tahir
items.summary: Dignity applies to disability, ageing, and any situation where a person’s worth may become less visible because of what they cannot or can no longer do, or because their contributions are not socially valued. The post What Does Dignity Look Like? — Sharifah Tahir appeared first on CodeBlue .

items.title: The MediAsas Mirage: How Malaysia’s Flagship Health Plan Betrayed Its Promise To The Chronically Ill — Dr Rajeentheran Suntheralingam
items.summary: The betrayal of the chronically ill is not merely a failure of MediAsas' product design. It is a failure of political will – a refusal to confront the uncomfortable truth that voluntary, market-driven insurance cannot deliver universal protection. The post The MediAsas Mirage: How Malaysia’s Flagship Health Plan Betrayed Its Promise To The Chronically Ill — Dr Rajeentheran Suntheralingam appeared first on CodeBlue .

items.title: Ex-Hospital Director Transferred To Avoid Interference With Further Probe: Dzulkefly
items.summary: Health Minister Dr Dzul says a former hospital director in Kota Kinabalu was transferred to JKNS to avoid potential interference with a further probe into sexual harassment claims and that the transfer of the medical officer wasn't a demotion of his grade. The post Ex-Hospital Director Transferred To Avoid Interference With Further Probe: Dzulkefly appeared first on CodeBlue .

items.summary: Potential areas highlighted included improving access to animal health innovations, antimicrobial resistance and stewardship, antiparasitic management, veterinary education and other areas where academia and industry can jointly address emerging needs.
